reforms.description: The 1981 Economic Recovery Tax Act (ERTA) introduced significant tax cuts and an Accelerated Cost Recovery System (ACRS) for capital allowances, aimed at stimulating business investment.
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: By reducing tax burdens and enhancing capital allowances, the reform is expected to incentivize business investment and stimulate economic growth.
reforms.status_evidence: The tax cuts and ACRS provisions were enacted as part of the 1981 Economic Recovery Tax Act.
reforms.importance_rationale: The reform represents a structural change in tax policy aimed at enhancing investment incentives, with significant implications for economic growth.
reforms.source_quote: The 1981 Economic Recovery Tax Act (ERTA) made across-the-board cuts in income tax rates and introduced an Accelerated Cost Recovery System (ACRS) for capital allowances.
